candidates.name: Lupus vulgaris
support_spans: painless discrete cutaneous nodules
Light red livedo reticularis on limbs
Mild hypoaesthesia on the extensor side of the knee and ankle
candidates.why: The patient presents with cutaneous nodules and livedo reticularis, which are common features of lupus vulgaris.

candidates.name: Erythema nodosum
support_spans: 17 red nodules measuring 0.5–1 cm in diameter
Some nodules firm, others soft in texture
candidates.why: The patient has multiple red nodules, which is a characteristic feature of erythema nodosum.

candidates.name: Leprosy
support_spans: Abundant acid-fast bacilli within histiocytes
Earlobe tissue fluid showed acid-fast bacilli (Bacterial Index 4.8)
candidates.why: The presence of acid-fast bacilli within histiocytes suggests a mycobacterial infection, which is consistent with leprosy.

candidates.name: Sarcoidosis
support_spans: Nodular infiltrates of foamy histiocytes in dermis arranged in storiform pattern
candidates.why: The histopathological findings of nodular infiltrates of foamy histiocytes are consistent with sarcoidosis.
